# The Botan3 RNP integration sets language mode on the library and both command tools

The owned RNP build update changes its Botan generated-header include to build/include/public and selects C++20 for the shared library within the Botan backend branch. Windows uses /std:c++20; other targets use -std=c++20 and add -pthread to that library linker flags. rnp-cli and rnpkeys each select C++20 outside a backend conditional and link against rnp. The parent RNP directory includes both command-tool directories, so the language-mode change covers all three consumers rather than only Botan own compilation. System Botan CFLAGS, generated headers, language mode and link flags remain distinct inputs. Accepted later backend/version metadata is not attributed to this patch. These platform conditions do not establish every compiler or old-system binary is compatible. No compiler, link, CLI or test ran.

Scope: third-party/openpgp/rnp-build.
